title: Going green with AVEVA PI System
summary: ENTEGA uses PI Interfaces at each renewable site to feed a central PI Server covering 11 wind parks, 3 solar parks, 2 biogas plants and 130 PV plants. PI was adopted in 2015.
challenge: Many SCADA systems from many manufacturers made reporting slow, "very inefficient and time consuming".
solution: PI became a single source of truth. The in-house tool Cogent shows online values, KPIs and forecasts, colour-codes turbines red, yellow or green, and compares theoretical with actual power for each turbine.

outcomes.text: No measured PI outcome figures are stated. Scale figures only: "over 600,000 customers" and "€850M" invested in renewables.

title: Xcel Energy uses AVEVA PI System to improve wind forecasting
summary: Xcel Energy uses PI-based forecasting to predict wind lulls hours ahead, so its coal and gas units can ramp up in time.
challenge: Unexpected drops in wind forced costly fast starts of thermal plants.
solution: Wind forecasting built on PI System data.

outcomes.text: "Savings and efficiencies are roughly estimated over the last six years at $46 million"
outcomes.reportedBy: Kasen Huwa, Xcel Energy, in an AVEVA success story (OSIsoft's company overview also cites $46 million over six years)

outcomes.text: More than $7 million per year
outcomes.reportedBy: Kasen Huwa, Xcel Energy, in an AVEVA success story (OSIsoft's company overview also cites $46 million over six years)

title: Fingrid Oyj increases innovation with AVEVA PI System
summary: Fingrid, the Finnish grid operator, automates the analysis and visualisation of grid measurement data with PI System and PI Vision.
challenge: Fingrid needed to develop algorithms that use its measurement data efficiently.
solution: PI System with PI Vision, automatic fault processing and modelling on live data.

outcomes.text: Prevented "numerous potential faults across three 400 megavolt amperes transformers" (no other figures)

title: PJM uses AVEVA PI System to visualize the electric grid in real time
summary: PJM's Dispatch Interactive Map Application (DIMA) combines PI data with Esri ArcGIS to overlay line status and weather radar for grid dispatchers.
challenge: PJM needed to combine geographic and grid data and display "1.6 million pieces of information".
solution: PI data integrated with Esri ArcGIS in the DIMA application.

outcomes.text: Improved dispatcher situational awareness (no figures given)

title: Alectra improves utility maintenance with AVEVA PI System monitoring
summary: Alectra Utilities built a reliability-centred maintenance (RCM3) strategy on PI condition monitoring of its transformer fleet.
challenge: Scheduled maintenance did not scale with a growing transformer fleet.
solution: PI-based condition monitoring with PI Vision.

outcomes.text: A transformer issue was repaired for $100,000, avoiding a potential $3 million replacement
A hydrogen monitor was repaired before failure

title: AGL uses AVEVA PI System data to prevent failures and cut maintenance
summary: AGL centralised its SCADA data in PI System and shares wind and solar data with partners through CONNECT data services, as its capacity grew from 300 MW in 2012 to more than 10,000 MW in 2021.
challenge: A rapid energy transition and SCADA data scattered across many systems.
solution: PI System plus CONNECT data services for cloud sharing with partners.

outcomes.text: "Saved millions in avoided failures and maintenance costs"
Data capture time cut from 10 mins to 1 sec across 200 wind turbines

title: Thermal performance analysis with PI Asset Framework
summary: Luminant consolidated 13 thermal performance applications into PI AF templates, using substitution parameters and converting Excel calculations to AF analyses with backfill.
challenge: Three tools and 13 applications were in use, each needing its own expertise.
solution: AF templates with substitution parameters; Excel calculations converted to AF analysis templates with backfill.

outcomes.text: Saved $160K on its most recent combined-cycle unit (third-party applications historically cost "$100K+ per unit")
outcomes.reportedBy: The company (Jackson, Luminant) in a 2017 OSIsoft regional seminar

title: Using the power of PI AF to create centralised management reporting at Longannet
summary: Longannet Power Station moved 83 management metrics into a site/unit AF model; 24 of them are calculated by PI ACE every 10 minutes, with AF tables for shifts, coal diet and outages.
challenge: Metrics lived in spreadsheets, and the station was planning life extension beyond 2020.
solution: An AF metrics model with site elements above unit elements, and AF tables for rotas, shifts, coal diet and planned outages.

outcomes.text: Availability up 12.4% (2014 YTD vs 2013)
outcomes.reportedBy: Capula Ltd in an OSIsoft EMEA 2014 presentation

outcomes.text: Tube leaks down 0.14 per 1000 running hours (2014 YTD vs 2013)
outcomes.reportedBy: Capula Ltd in an OSIsoft EMEA 2014 presentation

outcomes.text: NOx reduced by 0.1 t/GWh (2014 YTD vs 2013)
outcomes.reportedBy: Capula Ltd in an OSIsoft EMEA 2014 presentation

title: PI as a unifying data layer across a generation fleet
summary: Tenaga Nasional Berhad (TNB) deployed PI in-house as a unifying data layer across its diverse generation fleet, and also sells PI deployment services.
challenge: A diverse fleet with no common data layer.
solution: PI as the unifying data layer, implemented in-house.

outcomes.text: Over USD 7 million savings from in-house implementation
outcomes.reportedBy: OSIsoft in a 2015 São Paulo seminar deck

outcomes.text: Over USD 10 million tangible savings from plant analysis and optimisation
outcomes.reportedBy: OSIsoft in a 2015 São Paulo seminar deck

title: PI with Esri ArcGIS for offshore wind
summary: DONG Energy combined PI System and Esri ArcGIS for asset integrity and logistics across 1,800 offshore wind turbines.
challenge: Offshore work is about 15 times more expensive than onshore work.
solution: Condition-based and predictive monitoring on PI data.

outcomes.text: Could "cut OPEX by up to about €20M per year (NPV)" (an expectation, not a measured result)
outcomes.reportedBy: OSIsoft (2015 seminar deck; the OSIsoft company overview also cites €20 million)

verifyNote: The €20M figure is an expected saving, not a measured result.

title: Building a cloud-enabled, unified asset environment
summary: Dominion Energy built an AF SDK application that automatically keeps an "evergreen" AF model of about 28,000 elements and more than 135,000 analyses up to date from SCADA, EMS, ADMS, SAP and GIS data.
challenge: Thousands of assets are added or retired every week, and data was siloed.
solution: An AF SDK auto-builder for the AF model, plus CONNECT for data sharing.

outcomes.text: 50% increase in speed-to-market for environmental data
42 potential equipment failures identified and prevented in one year
New use cases in days instead of months

title: Delivering safe, reliable, and sustainable power
summary: Ontario Power Generation runs more than 1,200 AI predictive models, fed from PI, for condition-based maintenance across its nuclear and hydro fleet.
challenge: A high-risk operating environment and a reactive maintenance culture.
solution: More than 1,200 AVEVA Predictive Analytics models fed from PI System.

outcomes.text: Up to $4 million (USD) efficiency savings in the first 24 months
$400,000 from one nuclear catch and $200,000 from one hydro catch
3,000 annual maintenance hours redirectable

title: The world's largest nuclear facility powers digital transformation with data-centric processes
summary: Bruce Power consolidated 40,000 PI tags, plus documents and equipment codes, into AVEVA Asset Information Management (AIM), with live PI Vision data embedded in AIM workflows.
solution: Live PI Vision data embedded in AIM workflows, alongside Point Cloud Manager and CONNECT.

outcomes.text: 1000 employee hours saved
15% savings in avoided repeat walkdowns
30% execution savings
50% savings at engineering change closeout

verifyNote: These outcomes are mostly attributable to AIM and engineering tools rather than PI System alone.

title: The power of communication: how Kansai used the PI System to transform its power plants
summary: Kansai Electric brought all nine of its power plants into PI System and built equipment digital twins in AF, after market reforms ended its regional monopoly.
challenge: Market deregulation ended its regional monopoly.
solution: PI System plus AF equipment digital twins.

outcomes.text: "Savings of $3 million a year in one plant alone"
